## COMPUTATION OF INCOME FROM LET-OUT HOUSE PROPERTY

| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| 2. | Less: Corporation/ Municipal Tax actually paid by the owner in the year | B |
